instructions.title: Enter the Terrain Rover
instructions.message: Approach the rover ladder and enter the vehicle.
instructions.guidance: Navigate to the Terrain Rover parked on the surface. Approach the ladder on the rear right side and press E to climb into the cabin.
instructions.activity: Approach the rover ladder and press E to enter the rover interior.

instructions.title: Initiate the Mission
instructions.message: Access the main computer and create the initial mission log.
instructions.guidance: Locate the main computer console at the front of the cabin. Open the Mission OS and submit the initial mission log.
instructions.activity: Approach Main_Screen_Trigger and press E to open the Mission Operating System.

instructions.title: Check Environmental Conditions
instructions.message: Review external pressure, temperature, wind and atmospheric composition.
instructions.guidance: Proceed to the environment checking station inside the rover. Verify surface conditions and save the observation log.
instructions.activity: Approach Environment_Checking_Trigger and press E to record environmental readings.

instructions.title: Inspect Available Tools
instructions.message: Inspect the rover equipment and confirm the tools available for surface investigation.
instructions.guidance: Locate the tool section storage locker. Inspect the sampling tool, containers, and sensors, then confirm the inventory checklist.
instructions.activity: Approach Tool_Section_Trigger and press E to inspect and confirm the tool inventory.

instructions.title: Check Water and Nutrient Supplies
instructions.message: Inspect available water and nutrient resources and record their current levels.
instructions.guidance: Examine the life-support resource dispenser. Record water and nutrient levels into the mission log.
instructions.activity: Approach Water_and_nut_Trigger and press E to record resource reserves.

instructions.title: Travel to the Second Checkpoint
instructions.message: Return to the driving station and navigate to the second observation checkpoint.
instructions.guidance: Enter the driving section and follow the dynamic navigation beam toward 2ndCheckpoint across the Elysium traverse.
instructions.activity: Enter driving mode and drive the rover to the 2ndCheckpoint waypoint.

instructions.title: Record the Second Observation
instructions.message: Inspect the updated environmental readings and record the second observation in the mission operating system.
instructions.guidance: Stop the rover, enter the interior cabin, and inspect the updated computer screens. Submit the second observation log in the Mission OS.
instructions.activity: Approach Main_Screen_Trigger and press E to save the Second Observation Log.

instructions.title: Proceed to the SOL 01 Destination
instructions.message: Return to driving mode and navigate to the final destination of SOL 01.
instructions.guidance: Resume rover driving mode and follow the navigation beam to Finishing_Point to complete SOL 01.
instructions.activity: Drive the rover to Finishing_Point to conclude the Sol 01 expedition.

completion.title: SOL 01 Expedition Complete
completion.message: All Sol 01 surface reconnaissance objectives achieved. SOL 02 traverse is now unlocked.
